Tom plays badminton with Mia every Wednesday. Tom and Mia had great fun there. Tom usually has salad for breakfast. Wash your hands before dinner.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. There are always many people at the train station. They took many photos at the train station. Also, teachers try to instil a love of reading early.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the hotel by bike. Both of them like salad and milk. Tom is reading a book about math. Best of all, I take the bus to work.
Tom thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. Last Wednesday, Tom and Mia went to the hotel. The hotel is one of the best places in the city.
